metadata.description: Pruna Skills — generative media agent skills for the Pruna AI API

plugins.name: avatar-multi-scene
plugins.description: Use when someone wants the same person hosting several clips — multi-segment UGC, comparison reels, or mixed speaking and animated scenes with continuity.

plugins.name: avatar-single-scene
plugins.description: Use when someone wants one polished host-on-camera beat — a speaking person with intake and approval gates before generation.

plugins.name: gemini-3.1-flash-tts
plugins.description: Use when someone needs spoken narration or voiceover — explainer tracks, documentary lines, or voice to pair with generated video.

plugins.name: generation-diversity
plugins.description: Use when generations look generic or samey — vary seeds, prompt structure, and scenario axes before the next paid image, video, or audio call.

plugins.name: generation-quality-checklists
plugins.description: Use when reviewing generated images, videos, or audio before shipping — run the quality checklists before asking for approval.

plugins.name: illustrated-story-reel
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a slideshow story with narration or music — picture-book style illustrated frames, not full motion video.

plugins.name: image-to-video
plugins.description: Use when someone wants one short film beat from images — a narrated scene, story moment, or cinematic B-roll with optional voiceover.

plugins.name: interactive-explainer
plugins.description: Use when someone wants an educational explainer with a host and characters — history or science shorts with dialogue, not voiceover-only B-roll.

plugins.name: music-2.5
plugins.description: Use when someone wants an original AI song with vocals — sung lyrics, a style prompt track, or source audio for a music video.

plugins.name: music-video
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a full music video — original song or vocals, performance clips, B-roll, and lyric-synced edits.

plugins.name: narrated-multi-scene
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a multi-part story with voiceover — episodic B-roll, chaptered promo, or several linked video scenes without on-camera dialogue.

plugins.name: p-image
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a fast AI image — product shots, hero visuals, mood boards, or draft photos from a text prompt.

plugins.name: p-image-edit
plugins.description: Use when someone wants to edit an existing photo — change outfits or backgrounds, compose from reference images, or apply prompt-driven edits.

plugins.name: p-image-try-on
plugins.description: Use when someone wants virtual try-on — dress a person in clothes from reference photos for fashion or ecommerce.

plugins.name: p-image-upscale
plugins.description: Use when someone wants to upscale or sharpen an existing image for print, large crops, or higher-quality delivery.

plugins.name: p-video
plugins.description: Use when someone wants one short video clip from text or images — B-roll, start/end frame animation, or a quick motion shot. Not for full multi-scene films or lip-synced hosts.

plugins.name: p-video-animate
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a photo to move like another video — motion transfer, dance remixes, or performance variations from a template clip.

plugins.name: p-video-avatar
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a person on camera speaking a script — lip-synced host, spokesperson, or narrated avatar from a portrait photo.

plugins.name: p-video-replace
plugins.description: Use when someone wants to swap a person, outfit, or product inside existing footage while keeping the camera move and audio.

plugins.name: pruna-full
plugins.description: All 26 Pruna skills in one plugin. Multi-scene workflows use staged approval (plan → stills → clips before paid video) via requesting-generation-feedback, and parallel subagents per scene lane after you confirm — parent agent merges results.

plugins.name: pruna-generative-pipeline
plugins.description: Use when someone is unsure which production fits — need a menu for chained images, video, and audio with staged approval. Not for a single known tool call.

plugins.name: pruna-run
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a quick one-off generation — one image, video clip, edit, or speaking avatar from a prompt, with minimal intake.

plugins.name: recipe-catalog
plugins.description: Use when browsing recipe ideas for mood boards, hero images, explainers, music videos, or avatar reels and need the linked tools. For a live multi-step project, prefer the generative pipeline.

plugins.name: requesting-generation-feedback
plugins.description: Use when about to spend on generation — pause for review of prompts, images, or clips before the next paid step. Not after the user already approved the current phase.

plugins.name: stable-audio-2.5
plugins.description: Use when someone wants light instrumental background music — an ambient bed under dialogue or underscore for reels and explainers.

plugins.name: visual-transition-reel
plugins.description: Use when someone wants a montage with transitions between shots — action-sequence reel or multi-scene piece where narration is optional.

plugins.name: whisperx
plugins.description: Use when someone needs word-level lyric timestamps or cut-safe line boundaries before editing music-video clips.
